about: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next EXL3 3.05bpw_h5_ng5 on one Intel Arc Pro B70 inside 32 GiB of host RAM: routed experts read with O_DIRECT from a packed NVMe store into a 7 GB RAM tier behind an 8,000-slot device-managed VRAM expert cache, staged NVMe prefill, SYCL sparse attention (qwen38-flash-next-b70-offload, QWEN_B70_MODE=nvme32, campaign run N130)
setup: NEEDS: 1x Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB (xe driver), passed in as its render node only (ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0 selects the one visible device; pass only the chosen card's /dev/dri/renderD node, not the whole /dev/dri, on hosts with several Intel GPUs); the container is capped at 32 GiB (resources: --memory 32g --memory-swap 32g, swap off inside the cap; RAM expert tier 7 GB), --ulimit memlock=-1, --shm-size 8g; 8 CPU threads (measured with --cpuset-cpus pinned to 8 threads); disk: the 85.1 GB checkpoint (non-expert weights read at load, the 32.6 GB n-gram table random-read with O_DIRECT while serving) plus the 45.8 GB packed expert store on a local NVMe filesystem that supports O_DIRECT (xfs, ext4), measured on 4x Samsung 9100 PRO md RAID0 xfs (reads 0.3-2.3 GB/s during decode, 4-6 GB/s during prefill). PREPARE (once, CPU only): `pack-store` packs the routed experts (48 x 512 x 1.86 MB) from the read-only checkpoint into /nvx/qwen_experts.bin + qwen_experts.json and byte-compares 64 records read back with O_DIRECT; `verify-store` repeats the check. The server probes the store and O_DIRECT on /nvx before it starts and serves /nvx read-only. The VRAM expert cache starts empty: the first answer after start can be poor; send a warm-up request. MEASURED: image d30df691 on omarchy (same box and conditions): 8k prefill 1,061 / 1,169 tok/s at 1 / 4 streams, decode 25.2 / 33.9 tok/s total; 32k C1 prefill 1,131, decode 26.3; campaign run N130 c32 (srv23 settings, same session as f16): 8k C1 25.6 / C2 30.5 / C4 32.4, 32k C1 27.3 / C2 31.3, prefill 1,135-1,321. QUALITY: not exact: decode masks expert picks that are in neither VRAM nor RAM; paired decode-vs-prefill KL 0.021 nats, top-1 0.963; teacher-forced reference panel vs exllamav3 top-1 0.984, KL 0.0028. Text only. Raw: github.com/sybil-solutions/qwen38-flash-next-b70-offload docs/results.md, results/n130.
